svg.text: Axial position a from the upstream nose; outer surface (12 mm plate shell assumed).
1. Shell of S355J2+N plate 12 mm, formed in gores and rings,
full-penetration butt welds (EN ISO 5817 level B), internal ring
2. Watertight: air test at 0.5 bar with soap solution on all seams,
then 0.2 bar hold for 1 h without loss.
3. Outer surface fair within ±3 mm of the profile over any 1 m
TEACHING MODEL — materials, tolerances and wall thicknesses are assumptions. Not for construction.
